name: A Big Wheel RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 30.8373,-81.5645: RV rows among live oaks west of the highway; a small pond in the park's south corner is not at the rows and Crooked River is off-frame - not waterfront

name: Bear Branch RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.54742,-82.12780: a few units at the head of a wooded cove of the George L. Smith millpond, under canopy; no pad confirmable at the water's edge - not waterfront (default down, low confidence: units appear within ~20 m of the cove)

name: Starlit Hollow RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.55668,-82.96768: sites in a clearing south of a pond, separated from it by ~150 m of woods and the road - not waterfront

name: Woodland RV Resort & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.3619,-83.3421: two rows of RVs in an open field east of the road; small pond ~250 m SE, not at the rows - not waterfront

name: Ted & Tracy's RV Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 33.6827,-82.6143: campers along a gravel lane in hardwood forest north of the highway; no water in frame - not waterfront

name: White Oak Pastures RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) around 31.522,-84.862: farm village and fields beside US-27; no water - not waterfront

name: Clay Hill Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 33.66575,-82.44085: loop roads on a peninsula with Thurmond Lake on three sides, but sites are under continuous canopy; no pad confirmable at the shoreline - not waterfront (default down; candidate for a per-site upgrade like Hester's Ferry)

name: War Hill Park Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m frame, leaf-off) at 34.33206,-83.96362: campground road runs south along the west shore of the peninsula ~40-60 m from the water under deciduous woods; no pad confirmable at the shoreline - not waterfront (default down; a review says swimming from the site, so a lakefront upgrade candidate)

name: Coleman Lake Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.8232,-82.2772: RVs scattered in an open field; the Ogeechee River runs ~100-150 m north behind a continuous tree belt - not waterfront
